annotations.title: Senior housing demand and supply for a state

description: One state's (or DC's) senior housing development picture: Census 75+ and 85+ population (April 2020 and July 2025) and growth vs the US, CMS certified nursing home beds and CDC assisted living beds per 1,000 older adults vs the US, certificate of need status for nursing homes and assisted living, HUD Section 232 new construction loans since FY2001, and a county table (largest, fastest-growing or thinnest nursing supply), or one county by name.

county.description: Optional: one county to return, e.g. "Maricopa" or "Maricopa County". Not available for Connecticut.

county_sort.description: County list order: largest 75+ population; fastest 75+ growth (counties with 2,000+ aged 75+); fewest nursing beds per 1,000 aged 85+ (counties with 1,000+ aged 85+).

offset.description: Skip this many counties, for paging.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full name, e.g. "FL" or "Florida". DC is included.

name: state_demand_supply
